newsitem.title: CANADA: Inco files IPO to sell Doncasters unit.
newsitem.headline: Inco files IPO to sell Doncasters unit.

text.p: Canadian mining giant Inco Ltd. said on Monday it planned to sell its engineered products business unit, Doncasters Plc, through an initial public offering.
Doncasters, formerly Inco Engineered Products, has filed a registration document in the United States for an underwritten public offering of 8 million American Depositary Shares.
Each ADS represents two ordinary shares of Doncasters.
Through the offering, Inco will be selling 100 percent of its interest in Doncasters, Inco said in a statement.
Doncasters manufactures speciality metals and alloys mainly for the aerospace and industrial turbine industries.
Doncasters' net sales were $149.8 million in 1995 and $128.3 million for the first nine months of 1996. It operates in Britain, the United States and Belgium.

A total of 5.6 million ADS will be initially offered to the public in the United States and on a private placement basis in Canada, Inco said. Another 2.4 million ADSs will be initially offered outside the United States and Canada.
Inco said it planned to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including repayment of debt stemming from its acquisition of Diamond Fields Resources Inc. earlier this year.
Inco said it planned to apply to list Doncasters on the New York Stock Exchange.
